INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< DISTRIBUTOR INSTALLATION
1. Turn the crankshaft to bring the piston in No.1 cylinder to the 
top dead center on the compression stroke.
2. Rotate the distributor shaft coupling until its notch (mating 
mark) is lined up with the notch (mating mark) in the 
housing.
3. Fit the distributor coupling in the slot at the rear end of the 
camshaft to install the distributor.
